goal: Find the best risk-adjusted use of GP using RuneLite/Wiki market data plus catalyst and community intelligence without forcing trades.

master_prompt_fingerprint.note: OPERATING_SPEC.md preserves the operational requirements in normalized form; this fingerprint identifies the exact user-supplied master prompt version used to build it.

market_source_policy: ONLY prices.runescape.wiki / RuneLite-fed real-time API. GitHub relay is transport/cache only.

report_requirements.pnl_basis: Use only confirmed holdings and cost bases; calculate gross mark-to-market and approximate after-tax realizable P/L from fresh Wiki/RuneLite-origin prices. Do not count unfilled offers as owned or sold. Flag asynchronous/crossed prints instead of pretending they are executable.
report_requirements.placement: Place P&L after the Portfolio/Portfolio Changes area unless another nearby location is clearer.

data_quality_rules: Newest explicit user portfolio statement overrides older portfolio snapshots.
A buy/sell offer is not a fill unless the user confirms execution.
Historical research price bands are context only and must never substitute for live market data.
Official proposal language is not the same as poll passage or implementation.
Community speculation is never promoted to fact without official corroboration.
Unknown portfolio fields belong in data_gap_register.json rather than being guessed.
Known news belongs in news_baseline.json so old catalysts are not relabeled NEW.
Only user-confirmed executions may be treated as empirical scanner outcomes.
